notes.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition is Steam Deck Verified ahead of release
notes.notes: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition from Survios releases on September 30th and ahead of release Valve rated it Steam Deck Verified / SteamOS Compatible.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/alien-rogue-incursion-evolved-edition-is-steam-deck-verified-ahead-of-release/
